description: Rehabilitation of road Infrastructure damaged due to the cyclone Ditwah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited, following the national competitive procurement method, for the selection of contractors to rehabilitate and improve several road sections damaged by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High-Level Procurement Committees following the evaluation of the bids so received, the Cabinet approved the proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive lowest bidders, as follows:



Serial No.
Contract
No. of Bids Received
Recommended Bidder
Contract Value(Excluding VAT)




01

                Rehabilitation and improvement of road sections of the
                Gampola - Nawalapitiya Road (AB013) from Ch. 8+500 km to
                Ch. 16+300 km, Ulapane - Pussellawa Road (B431) from
                Ch. 0+000 km to Ch. 6+440 km and Atabage - Ulapane Road
                (B490) from Ch. 0+000 km to Ch. 7+500 km.
            
04

                Rs. 852.83 million
            


02

                Rehabilitation and improvement of the road section of
                16.77 km of the Wattegama - Kandenuwara - Wariyapola
                Road (B461) from Ch. 11+000 km to Ch. 27+700 km and
                improvement of drainage efficiency and construction
                relating to retaining walls of the road section of the
                said road from Ch. 27+700 km to Ch. 30+800 km.
